elements.text:
Each day, you will answer a few short questions about where you are in your menstrual cycle and whether you are having any menstrual symptoms. You can choose what time of day these questions appear.


You will also take an ovulation predictor kit (OPK) test on 5 days during the study. We will notify you on the days you need to take the test.


Questions? Contact Emily Vandersteen at yqt8fr@virginia.edu or (501) 515-2384.
